dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Ugh, what do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Typical! Young people these days! Care more about what's on their head than what's inside it...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: I'll have you know that ten years ago, everyone from Feiyun Slope down to the Dockyard knew the name Gentry De'an!

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Now? The bank's gone, Chu's gone... It's such a pity! I've lived this long only to watch everything fall apart at the end...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: #Hmph! {F#She}{M#He} wants to lend a hand! And just how do you expect to do that? Raise the dead? Magically recover my lost wealth?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* I used to have my own bank... The Minghua Company and the Minghua Bank used to be the two proudest stores on this whole street.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: But then those bankers from Snezhnaya started descending on the Liyue financial market... All thanks to backing from the Fatui, I might add, not an honest-to-god bootstrapper among them! Anyway... that marked the beginning of the end for the old guard...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: If I was a young man with some fight left in me, oh you can be sure I'd be fighting to make my comeback...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: But there's not much an old man like me can do now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: What about them? ...You've never heard of them?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: They came over here from Snezhnaya, flaunting their diplomatic immunity, then they started poking around in business circles, putting feelers out... I had a bad feeling about them from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Then they started interfering with my business... They were intent on getting Snezhnayan investment into Liyue one way or another.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: They were just relentless. Eventually, I had no choice but to sell off the bank to them. And the company? Who knows how much longer it will last. Business is getting worse by the day...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Hmph, well I hope I won't see you! Stay out of my sight.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: So many medicines, but no cure for heartache...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Hmph... My story has become a byword here in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Not a while back, I opposed my daughter Huachu's marriage to some beggar boy... and my sweet daughter, she threw herself down a well...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Why, oh why, did she have to fall for that indigent, rat-eyed schoolmaster? Ah, alas!

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: She'd rather live a pauper with him than let me arrange her affairs. I said but a few words, and then she... she...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: How could you be so foolish, Huachu...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: And you! Are you trying to rub salt in my wounds? Scram! Get lost! Don't bother me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: ...Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: ...A father burying his daughter...

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: Remember, Lantern Rite festival is not all fun and games!

dialogues.speaker: Gentry De'an
dialogues.text: The reason we celebrate is to remember the brave heroes who fought and died for Liyue. Enjoy the festival, but don't forget to spare a thought for them.
